local.description: Home Assistant listens for the station's UDP uploads. Discovered station: {discovered}. If enabled, setup sends the Hi-Flying UDP AT command that points the station at Home Assistant. Some modules may lose this setting after a power cycle, so Home Assistant checks it regularly and restores it when needed.
